name: Snapchat Conversion Events
shortInfo: Now push web, app, and offline events data from a user specified data warehouse to Snapchat.
brief: Snapchat is a fast and fun way to share the moment with your friends and family.
about:
The Snapchat Conversion API integration is a structured, privacy-centric interface that allows you to directly pass web, app, and offline events to Snap via a Server-to-Server integration.

Learn more about [Snapchat Conversion API](https://marketingapi.snapchat.com/docs/conversion.html).
availableSync:
[Create Conversion Event](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/snapchat/syncs/create-conversion-event.html)

This sync can be used to upload web, app, and offline events data from a user specified datawarehouse to the Snapchat platform.
